definition: The source applies to the scheme as a whole rather than to an individual parcel or boundary within the scheme.
The source applies to a cadastral parcel as a whole.

The source applies to a boundary or boundary definition of a cadastral parcel or parcel part.

The source applies to the dataset, submission, or encoded cadastral representation as a whole rather than to an individual scheme, parcel, or boundary.
